extracted.intended_audience: attorneys seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; counsel and participants in USPTO attorney discipline proceedings
extracted.subtask_description: Petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO considered under the Office of Enrollment and Discipline procedures (citing 37 C.F.R. § 11.58). The Director reviews the petition, any supporting affidavit(s), and all record information material to eligibility before deciding whether to grant reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Wiklof has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petition included an affidavit submitted under the regulatory provision cited (37 C.F.R. § 11.58); presence of such an affidavit is part of the supporting materials considered in a reinstatement petition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's review of petition, affidavit, and record information material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director considers the petition, supporting affidavit(s), and all record information material to eligibility; based on that review the Director may determine reinstatement is appropriate and grant the petition (as occurred here: "Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.").
